import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int N;
    static List<String> A, B;
    static List<List<Integer>> dists;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, cap, w;
        Edge(int a, int b, int c, int d) {
            u = a;
            v = b;
            cap = c;
            w = d;
        }
    }

    static class MCMF {
        int nodes;
        List<Integer> d, f, p;
        List<Edge> e;
        int flow, cost;

        void reset(int n) {
            nodes = n;
            d = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, Integer.MAX_VALUE));
            f = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, 0));
            p = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, -1));
        }

        void connect(int a, int b, int c, int w) {
            e.add(new Edge(a, b, c, w));
            e.add(new Edge(b, a, 0, -w));
        }

        void find_path(int s, int t) {
            reset(nodes);
            f.set(s, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            d.set(s, 0);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            List<Boolean> inq = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(nodes, false));
            q.offer(s);
            inq.set(s, true);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq.set(u, false);
                for (int i = 0; i < e.size(); ++i) {
                    Edge ed = e.get(i);
                    if (ed.cap > 0 && d.get(ed.v) > d.get(ed.u) + ed.w) {
                        d.set(ed.v, d.get(ed.u) + ed.w);
                        f.set(ed.v, Math.min(f.get(ed.u), ed.cap));
                        p.set(ed.v, i);
                        if (!inq.get(ed.v)) {
                            q.offer(ed.v);
                            inq.set(ed.v, true);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void run(int s, int t) {
            if (s == t) {
                flow = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                cost = 0;
                return;
            }
            flow = 0;
            cost = 0;
            while (true) {
                find_path(s, t);
                if (f.get(t) == 0) break;
                for (int cur = t; cur != s; cur = e.get(p.get(cur)).u) {
                    int rev = p.get(cur) ^ 1;
                    Edge forward = e.get(p.get(cur));
                    Edge backward = e.get(rev);
                    forward.cap -= f.get(t);
                    backward.cap += f.get(t);
                    cost += forward.w * f.get(t);
                }
                flow += f.get(t);
            }
        }
    }

    static final int IN(int x) { return 2 * (x); }
    static final int OUT(int x) { return 2 * (x) + 1; }

    static MCMF solver = new MCMF();
    static int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static void bfs(int sr, int sc, List<List<Integer>> dist) {
        dist.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                row.add(-1);
            }
            dist.add(row);
        }
        dist.get(sr).set(sc, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(sr * N + sc);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int cur = q.poll();
            int r = cur / N;
            int c = cur % N;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                int nr = r + dr[i];
                int nc = c + dc[i];
                if (nr < 0 || nr >= N || nc < 0 || nc >= N || dist.get(nr).get(nc) != -1 || A.get(nr).charAt(nc) == 'Y') continue;
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(nr).charAt(nc)) && B.get(nr).charAt(nc) != '0' && 
                    (dist.get(r).get(c) + 1 <= dists.get(nr).get(nc) || dists.get(nr).get(nc) == -1)) {
                    dist.get(nr).set(nc, dist.get(r).get(c) + 1);
                    if (dist.get(nr).get(nc) != dists.get(nr).get(nc)) {
                        q.offer(nr * N + nc);
                    }
                } else if (dists.get(nr).get(nc) == -1 || dists.get(nr).get(nc) > dist.get(r).get(c) + 1) {
                    dist.get(nr).set(nc, dist.get(r).get(c) + 1);
                    q.offer(nr * N + nc);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void init_all(List<String> m, List<List<List<Integer>>> all) {
        all.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            all.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(m.get(i).charAt(j)) && m.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    List<List<Integer>> temp = new ArrayList<>();
                    bfs(i, j, temp);
                    all.set(i * N + j, temp);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void add_link(int i1, int j1, int i2, int j2) {
        int u = i1 * N + j1;
        int v = i2 * N + j2 + N * N;
        solver.connect(OUT(u), IN(v), 1000000, 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        N = n;
        List<String> a = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> b = new ArrayList<>();
        int si = -1, sj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            a.add(line);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    si = i;
                    sj = j;
                }
            }
        }
        A = a;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            b.add(br.readLine());
        }
        B = b;
        List<List<Integer>> temp = new ArrayList<>();
        List<List<List<Integer>>> all_dists = new ArrayList<>();
        dists = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                row.add(1000000000);
            }
            dists.add(row);
        }
        bfs(si, sj, temp);
        dists = temp;
        init_all(A, all_dists);
        solver.reset(4 * N * N + 2);
        int src = 4 * N * N;
        int dst = src + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N * N; ++i) {
            solver.connect(src, IN(i), 1000000, 0);
            solver.connect(OUT(N * N + i), dst, 1000000, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(A.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    solver.connect(IN(idx), OUT(idx), 0, A.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int idx = i * N + j + N * N;
                    solver.connect(IN(idx), OUT(idx), 0, B.get(i).charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(B.get(i).charAt(j)) && B.get(i).charAt(j) != '0') {
                    for (int k = 0; k < all_dists.size(); ++k) {
                        if (!all_dists.get(k).isEmpty()) {
                            int x = k / N;
                            int y = k % N;
                            if (all_dists.get(k).get(i).get(j) == -1 || all_dists.get(k).get(i).get(j) > t) continue;
                            add_link(x, y, i, j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        solver.run(src, dst);
        System.out.println(solver.flow);
    }
}
